title: Terms of use
description: The conditions for using Milimon, its calculator and its study content.

the-service.heading: The service
paragraphs: Milimon is a free tool to study and calculate food costs. You can use it without an account; the account is optional and keeps your settings and calculations.

results.heading: Using the results
paragraphs: The formulas and examples follow the Food & Beverage Administration and Management handbook and are meant for learning. Results depend on the data you enter: check them before using them to set prices, buy or make business decisions.
The example taxes and rates are Argentina's and may change; check the current ones in your country.

your-account.heading: Your account
paragraphs: You sign in with your Google or Facebook account, and their own terms apply too. You are responsible for what you do with your session. You can delete your account at any time from “My account”.

content.heading: Content
paragraphs: The texts, explanations, logo and design are part of Milimon. You may use them to study; ask for permission to republish them.

changes.heading: Changes
paragraphs: We may update these terms or the tool. If a change is significant, this page will show it with the update date.
